title: Characterization of the binding process between gallic acid and trivalent chromium in tannery wastewater: a spectroscopic perspective
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00621F, Paper
Situ Mu, Qi Yang, Chenxu Yan, Tong Xu, Jing Zhang, Junjun Ma, Chun Liu
UV and FTIR spectroscopy combined with 2DCOS reveal that the binding sequence of GA with Cr3+ is meta-hydroxyl groups → carboxyl groups → para-hydroxyl groups.
